items.name: Middle-aged and Senior Song and Dance Troupe
items.body: The group rehearses songs and dance performances in a fun and welcoming environment. Members enjoy staying active, sharing their love of music and dance, preserving Chinese cultural traditions, and performing at community events and festivals.

items.name: Ballroom & Latin Dance Group
items.body: The ballroom and Latin (cha-cha-cha) dance group practices, and enjoys ballroom and Latin dancing in a fun and supportive environment. Members improve their dancing skills, stay active, make new friends, and participate in community performances and cultural events.

items.name: Mahjong Group
items.schedule: Hours: 6:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m., Tuesday through Sunday, in downtown Ottawa
items.body: A friendly Mahjong group for older seniors to enjoy recreation, social interaction, and companionship almost daily in a welcoming environment.

items.name: Multicultural Folk Dance Group
items.body: The group practices and performs multicultural folk dances that celebrate the rich cultural traditions of diverse communities in Canada. Members enjoy physical activity, artistic expression, and friendship while promoting cultural exchange, mutual understanding, and community engagement through performances, workshops, and special events.
